entities.summary: Augustos Zerlendis sometimes spelled Avgoustos Zerlentis was a Greek tennis player who competed at the 1920 Olympic Games in Antwerp. He reached the fourth round of the 1920 Wimbledon Championships singles competition. Between 1927 and 1931, he played in seven ties for the Greek Davis Cup team.
